content.comment_body: Hello, I'm planning to purchase a [product_name] ([article_no]). Can I disable the 4 onboard analog inputs and use 8 analog inputs from 4 [product_name] modules? I need all inputs to be suitable for 4-20mA signals rather than 0-10V.
Yes, that's possible. In the software: File > Properties > Offline settings > I/O settings > Onboard AI settings

Yes, as described previously, you can do that. Alternatively, using 500 ohm resistors allows you to convert 4-20mA signals to 2-10V input if you don't require digital inputs, which is a more affordable solution.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to configure [product_name] systems with multiple analog expansion modules to handle specific 4-20mA input requirements, questioning if onboard analog inputs can be disabled in favor of these modules. Responses confirm that this setup can be managed via configuration options in the software, showcasing the system's flexible modularity.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to replace the onboard analog inputs entirely with those from several expansion modules in order to accommodate 4-20mA signals, looking for straightforward options to achieve this configuration.
